verdict.rationale: Snowflake's "Regulatory compliance" docs have per-certification pages for SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS, plus SOC 1 Type II, ISO-27001/27017/27018, FedRAMP Moderate/High and CSA STAR. That gives security reviewers documented attestations to work from. Missing for 10: any evidence of HIPAA attestation or BAA support (named in the story but absent from the listed certifications), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the attestation reports and how to obtain them.
